summary: Comprehensive backend+frontend testing of VETMECH B2B ordering platform. Backend: 31/31 pytest cases pass (auth, catalog, scheme engine, OTP, checkout, reorder, admin orders + status, admin CRUD for products/categories/brands/units/news/schemes, dashboard, settings, enquiries, careers). Frontend: full E2E purchase flow (product -> qty 10 -> cart with 10+5 scheme -> OTP verify (dev_otp shown via data-testid=dev-otp-hint) -> order created VM-2026-00006). Admin login -> dashboard -> orders list with new order -> order detail sheet -> status change to Confirmed -> Products page add-product dialog all working.

minor.issue: Product listing does not include 'active_schemes' field despite spec stating it should. Scheme info is only available via /cart/calculate. This may affect frontend badges/scheme labels on listings.

Response uses flat keys (today_orders, total_orders, sales_value) instead of a 'totals' object as described in the spec. status_counts, top_products, trend keys are present. Not breaking - frontend consumes it correctly.

action_items: OPTIONAL: expose active_schemes (or a compact scheme_label) on GET /api/products items so listing cards can render scheme badges without an extra call.
OPTIONAL: align dashboard response with spec by wrapping totals into a 'totals' object (or update spec).
critical_code_review_comments: Auth uses JWT Bearer tokens (not httpOnly cookies) as documented; admin token in localStorage vm_admin_token. Acceptable for this build; note that this is XSS-exposed.
OTP is returned in the API response as dev_otp (documented mock). Ensure this is removed in production.
/api/settings/whatsapp public route correctly returns 401 (Not authenticated) for anonymous access.
resolve_cart correctly applies compute_scheme; verified 10+5, 5+1, and MASTOBLISS special price 270 at qty>=30.
Order status change endpoint updates activity log and logs a whatsapp notification (mocked). Verified via GET /api/admin/orders/{id}.

Frontend Checkout uses data-testid attributes extensively (start-verification, dev-otp-hint, name-input, addr-line1, addr-pincode, addr-district, addr-state, confirm-order-btn) which enabled reliable automation.
test_credentials: Admin vetmechpharma@gmail.com / Admin@123; Customer: any 10-digit mobile, dev_otp returned in /api/auth/otp/request response and shown in UI via [data-testid=dev-otp-hint]
seed_data_creation: Tests created a few TEST_* customers/orders/categories/brands/units/news via API. Order VM-2026-00006 created via UI flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_vetmech_backend.py covers all major endpoints. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_vetmech_backend.py -v. For frontend, use data-testid selectors (start-verification, dev-otp-hint, confirm-order-btn). The state selector on checkout is a Radix combobox (open with click, pick [role=option]). Cart qty must be increased via +/- buttons; typing into number input alone did not update state in my run. Scheme engine works only at qty threshold (e.g., NERVIPHOS-BM needs qty=10). All notifications (WhatsApp/email) are mocked and logged to db.notification_logs.
rca of the issue: N/A - no failures. Two minor spec deviations noted (active_schemes not on listing, dashboard uses flat totals fields).
